input.rationale: Section 5.1 gives a workmanlike-standard services warranty and a compliance-with-laws covenant, which matches part of the preferred position, but it contains no conformance warranty for Deliverables/Materials, no warranty period, no no-malicious-code warranty, and no stated remedy (repair, replace, re-perform or refund). Section 5.4(c) then puts all Materials on an unqualified "AS IS" basis, so the disclaimer swallows any implied conformance obligation, and 5.2 makes 5.1 exclusive. That fails the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies) on material terms, so we have inserted a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty with the standard remedy and carved the express warranty out of the "AS IS" disclaimer. Support/maintenance under 11.1 and 12.2 is discretionary ("as reasonably determined by IBM") and does not supply an equivalent warranty remedy.

proposal.summary: Add a 90-day conformance/no-malicious-code warranty with repair, replace, re-perform or refund remedy, and carve the express warranty out of the "AS IS" disclaimer.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a 90-day conformance and no-malicious-code warranty for Materials with a repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy, and carved the express warranty out of the "AS IS" disclaimer, since Section 5.1 currently gives us no conformance warranty or remedy at all. Our playbook position is 12 months for software and 90 days for services; we have proposed the 90-day fallback here.

ops.text: c. for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Deliverable and all Materials provided by IBM will conform in all material respects to the applicable documentation and specifications and will be free of any virus, malicious or disabling code. Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 5.1 is, at IBM's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Deliverable or Materials, or a refund of the charges paid for the non-conforming Services, Deliverable or Materials.

ops.oldText: c. IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
ops.newText: c. EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1, IBM PROVIDES ALL MATERIALS AND ALL NON-IBM SERVICES
